cards.text: Elijah, the LORD's prophet, has just faced down the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel (1 Kings 18:20-40). Now Ahab, king of Israel, goes and tells his wife Jezebel (1 Kings 16:31) everything Elijah did, including how he killed all the prophets with the sword. Friend, you can feel this one coming.

cards.question: Jezebel hears it all. What does she do about Elijah?

answers.text: Sends him a messenger with a threat
Sends him a gift to make peace

cards.text: Her message: by this time tomorrow, she'll make his life like the lives of those he killed. Friend, that's not a threat, that's a CALENDAR INVITE.

cards.question: After everything on Mount Carmel, Elijah stands his ground and stays put when Jezebel's message comes. True or false?

cards.text: Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. One message and he's GONE, faster than I hop away from a hot oven, and friend, I'm hopping with a whole gold base attached.

cards.question: Elijah runs until he reaches ___ in Judah.

cards.text: He leaves his servant there and goes a day's journey into the wilderness, alone. Then he sits down under a broom tree, and I think he's running on empty.

cards.question: Alone under the broom tree, what does Elijah pray for?

answers.text: That the rain would keep falling

cards.text: Elijah says, "I have had enough, LORD," and then, "Take my life, for I am no better than my fathers." Then he lies down under the broom tree and falls asleep.

cards.question: While Elijah sleeps under the broom tree, the servant he left in Beersheba finds him and wakes him up. True or false?

cards.text: An angel touches him and says, "Get up and eat." I bet Elijah's looking around thinking, eat WHAT, friend, this is the wilderness.

cards.question: Right there by his head, Elijah finds a cake of ___ and a jar of water.

cards.text: Bread baked over hot coals, right by his head, and that's room service in the WILDERNESS! Elijah eats, drinks and lies right back down.

cards.question: After Elijah lies back down, the angel lets him sleep and never comes back. True or false?
The angel of the LORD touches Elijah a second time and tells him to get up and eat again. Why?

answers.text: The journey will be too much for him
Jezebel's messenger is about to find him
His servant is coming to take him home

cards.text: So Elijah gets up, eats and drinks. He hit snooze once, and friend, his alarm came BACK.

cards.question: Strengthened by that food, Elijah walks for ___ days and nights.
Elijah's long walk ends at ___, the mountain of God.

cards.text: On the mountain, Elijah enters a cave and spends the night, and after that walk I bet a cave feels like a five-star hotel. Then the word of the LORD comes to him: "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

cards.question: The LORD asks Elijah what he is doing there. How does Elijah begin his answer?

answers.text: He has been very zealous for the LORD
He has finished the work he was sent to do
He has come to ask the LORD for rain

cards.text: Then Elijah says the Israelites have forsaken the LORD's covenant, torn down His altars and killed His prophets with the sword.

cards.question: In the cave, Elijah tells the LORD he is the only one left. True or false?

cards.text: "I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well." Then the LORD tells him to go out and stand on the mountain, because the LORD is about to pass by.

cards.question: Before the LORD on the mountain, what comes first, tearing into the mountains and shattering the rocks?

cards.text: But the LORD was not in the wind, and after the wind comes an earthquake, and the LORD was not in the earthquake either. Rocks SHATTERING, ground shaking, and friend, I'd be back in that cave hugging my gold base.

cards.question: After the earthquake on the mountain, a third thing comes. What is it?
The LORD was in the fire on the mountain. True or false?

cards.text: Wind, earthquake, FIRE, all the big stuff, and the LORD wasn't in any of it. Then, after the fire, comes a still, small voice.

cards.question: When Elijah hears the still small voice, what does he do?

answers.text: Wraps his face in his cloak and steps out
Runs deeper into the back of the cave
Falls facedown and stays inside the cave

cards.text: At the mouth of the cave, a voice asks him the same question as before: "What are you doing here, Elijah?" And Elijah gives the very same answer, word for word.
Now the LORD gives Elijah a job: go back the way he came, to the Desert of Damascus. He walked ALL that way to get here, friend, and step one is TURN AROUND.

cards.question: In the Desert of Damascus, who is Elijah told to anoint as king over Aram?
The LORD also tells Elijah to anoint ___ as king over Israel and ___ to succeed him as prophet.

cards.text: Jehu will put to death whoever escapes Hazael's sword, and Elisha will put to death whoever escapes Jehu's. Then the LORD adds one more thing.

cards.question: The LORD has reserved ___ thousand in Israel whose knees have not bowed to Baal.

cards.text: SEVEN THOUSAND, and Elijah said he was the only one left! Then Elijah leaves and finds Elisha son of Shaphat, plowing with twelve teams of oxen, and he's with the twelfth.

cards.question: Elijah passes by Elisha in the field and throws his cloak around him. True or false?

cards.text: Elisha leaves the oxen and RUNS after Elijah. Twelve teams standing in the field, and he's OUT.

cards.question: Elisha asks Elijah for one thing before he follows him. What is it?

answers.text: To kiss his father and mother goodbye
To finish plowing the whole field first
To bring his brothers along with him

cards.text: Elijah tells him, "Go on back," and asks what he has done to him.

cards.question: Elisha takes his pair of oxen back to the farm and keeps working them. True or false?
What does Elisha do with his pair of oxen?

answers.text: Slaughters them and feeds the people
Gives them to his father to keep
Sells them to pay for the trip

cards.text: He uses the oxen's equipment for fuel, cooks the meat and gives it to the people, and they eat. Friend, he didn't just quit the job, he BURNED it and served the people.

cards.question: After the people eat, Elisha sets out to follow and serve Elijah. True or false?

findings.problem: The question types in stop 1 follow a fixed cycle. Cards 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 go multiple choice, true or false, fill in the blank, then repeat the same three-type order exactly.

rule.text: No formula. Which question type comes next, the order the types come in and where a blank falls are chosen naturally for each card. They never follow a pattern. No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

findings.problem: Stop 2 has 6 choice cards. Four are multiple choice (cards 2, 6, 8 and 11), two are true or false, and none are fill in the blank. Multiple choice dominates the stop by a wide margin.

rule.text: No formula. Which question type comes next, the order the types come in and where a blank falls are chosen naturally for each card. They never follow a pattern. No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

findings.problem: The card asks how Elijah begins his answer to the LORD. Nothing on the earlier cards lets the baker reason toward 'very zealous for the LORD' over the other two answers, so getting it right comes down to luck. It also asks the baker to guess the wording of Elijah's line. A better question would ask about something the setup supports, such as his complaint that he is the only one left.

rule.text: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.

findings.problem: The joke line 'I'd be back in that cave' suggests Elijah is already outside the cave during the wind and earthquake. Verse 13 shows he is still inside: only after hearing the voice does he go out and stand at the mouth of the cave. The line conflicts with what the text shows and muddies card 11, whose right answer is that he steps out.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

findings.problem: The card retells that the LORD was not in the wind or the earthquake. Those facts come from verse 11, but the card cites only 1 Kings 19:12. It should cite 1 Kings 19:11-12.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
